defects.problem: The listening text still places the first B at 28 s and the da capo/opening music at 46 s, based on printed-tempo arithmetic. The inspected audio/score traversal instead places bar 17 at 33.637 s and the returning G-sharp pickup at 51.825 s, followed by bar 9 at 52.546 s. At 46 s the first B is still underway. This directly contradicts the now-supported performed repeat order, although no structured bar pointers are present.

Remove the obsolete 44-second-pass calculation as evidence of an observed 46-second return. Describe the inferred AABAB traversal without claiming a renewed extra A repetition or an aural review.
